mapper.sql: COUNT(*) AS exposureCount, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS userCount, SUM(CASE WHEN click_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS clickCount, SUM(CASE WHEN favorite_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS favoriteCount, SUM(CASE WHEN cart_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cartCount, SUM(CASE WHEN purchase_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS purchaseCount, SUM(CASE WHEN click_time IS NOT NULL OR favorite_time IS NOT NULL OR cart_time IS NOT NULL OR purchase_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS exposureCount, SUM(CASE WHEN e.click_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS clickCount, SUM(CASE WHEN e.purchase_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS purchaseCount, AVG(CASE WHEN e.purchase_time IS NOT NULL AND e.order_id IS NOT NULL AND o.total_amount IS NOT NULL THEN o.total_amount ELSE NULL END) AS aov FROM analytics_recommendation_exposure e LEFT JOIN `order` o ON o.id = e.order_id WHERE e.user_id > 0
AND e.exposure_time >= #{startTime}

SELECT scene,
GROUP BY scene ORDER BY exposureCount DESC, scene ASC

SELECT segment_code AS segmentCode, MAX(segment_name) AS segmentName,
AND segment_code IS NOT NULL AND segment_code != '' GROUP BY segment_code ORDER BY exposureCount DESC, segmentCode ASC

SELECT algorithm,
AND algorithm IS NOT NULL AND algorithm != '' GROUP BY algorithm ORDER BY exposureCount DESC, algorithm ASC

SELECT algorithm, segment_code AS segmentCode, MAX(segment_name) AS segmentName,
AND algorithm IS NOT NULL AND algorithm != '' AND segment_code IS NOT NULL AND segment_code != '' GROUP BY algorithm, segment_code ORDER BY exposureCount DESC, algorithm ASC, segmentCode ASC

SELECT scene, algorithm,
AND scene IS NOT NULL AND scene != '' AND algorithm IS NOT NULL AND algorithm != '' GROUP BY scene, algorithm ORDER BY scene ASC, exposureCount DESC, algorithm ASC

SELECT source_type AS sourceType,
AND source_type IS NOT NULL AND source_type != '' GROUP BY source_type ORDER BY exposureCount DESC, sourceType ASC

SELECT reason_type AS reasonType,
AND reason_type IS NOT NULL AND reason_type != '' GROUP BY reason_type ORDER BY exposureCount DESC, reasonType ASC

SELECT model_version AS modelVersion,
AND model_version IS NOT NULL AND model_version != '' GROUP BY model_version ORDER BY exposureCount DESC, modelVersion ASC

SELECT DATE(exposure_time) AS statDate,
GROUP BY DATE(exposure_time) ORDER BY statDate ASC
